result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the top-right header action appears empty/missing its icon content.

issues.description: Circular button in the top-right header next to the delivery address appears empty - light grey circle showing only a small red notification dot with no icon, avatar image, or label inside.
issues.suggestion: Verify the intended content for this header action (profile avatar / notifications / cart) loads correctly; add a fallback placeholder icon with sufficient contrast and ensure the notification badge is anchored to a visible icon.
